LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.5 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Comprehension • Word recognition By the
Topic 2.6: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading 2.5 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Comprehension • Word recognition By the in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do presentations help in improving communication skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read short texts and match pictures of food items to their names (鸡肉、牛 肉、羊肉、猪肉、面包、蛋糕、饼 干、米饭、面条、大饼),

2. read sentences and fill in the blanks with the appropriate shopping places for different items (肉店、面包店、蔬菜 店、超市、饭店),

3. read short descriptions and categorise the food items with the corresponding places they can be bought with peers,

4. take turns reading simple dialogues on quantities of items (斤、公斤) for critique on intonation and tone by peers,

5. pick a card and read the text related to it with the appropriate tone and intonation,

6. work jointly to explore and discuss the different career prospects in the food and drinks industry.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read short texts and match pictures of food items to their names (鸡肉、牛 肉、羊肉、猪肉、面包、蛋糕、饼 干、米饭、面条、大饼),
2. read sentences and fill in the blanks with the appropriate shopping places for different items (肉店、面包店、蔬菜 店、超市、饭店),
3. read short descriptions and categorise the food items with the corresponding places they can be bought with peers,
4. take turns reading simple dialogues on quantities of items (斤、公斤) for critique on intonation and tone by peers,
5. pick a card and read the text related to it with the appropriate tone and intonation,
6. work jointly to explore and discuss the different career prospects in the food and drinks industry.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: the learner exhibits teamwork skills as they categorise the food items correctly with their

peers.

Values:
Responsibility: the learner engages in assigned roles and duties as they take turns reading texts related to food items.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Career guidance: this is promoted as the learner gains awareness of the different career prospects they can explore in the food

industry during the discussions.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of shopping for different items to their learning in Pre-technical Studies.
